narrative_purpose: Teaches that Pandora's land and ocean are not two networks but one closed loop of borrowed energy — the forest root web and the ocean Spirit Tree wired into a single planetary system, with energy flowing through living bodies and returning to the whole on death.
subject: A clean cross-section diagram of a whole world split into two coupled halves: on the left a forest of towering trees laced together at the roots by glowing filaments; on the right an ocean with a great Spirit Tree anchored to the seabed by a dense glowing root mass, and large whale-like creatures threading between the two; a continuous web of fine light runs across the middle of the frame joining the forest roots to the ocean roots into one ring, with faint looping light-paths suggesting matter flowing out of living bodies and returning to the network.
scene: A symbolic planetary cross-section, forest half meeting ocean half across the centre, the unifying network of light running through both and closing into a loop.
camera: A wide diagrammatic cross-sectional view holding both the forest and the ocean halves at matched scale.
light: Even diagrammatic light; the connecting network and root masses picked out in a cool cyan-teal glow as the living circuitry, the rest dim.
palette: Void-indigo base, the unifying network in Pandora cyan and living teal, forest and ocean masses in dim teal-grey.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with strong diagrammatic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the connecting network, the root masses and the whale-like nodes; soft and dim elsewhere.
composition: Two balanced halves left (forest) and right (ocean) joined by the glowing loop across the centre, dark margins above and below for callout labels.
consistency_notes: Inference-tier diagram: present land and ocean as one coupled system. Cool Pandora palette and from-within glow; leave open dark space around the loop for labels.
